description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Coveted Jewel to become a creature.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Coveted Jewel, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
